title: Merkalis: Conquest — Free Demo Ready on Steam
author: HexagonGamesHG
selftext:
Hey everyone! The free demo of Merkalis: Conquest is available on Steam. 😎

How I used AI:

3D models: generated in Meshy AI, then cleaned up by hand. The army units are faction knights, which I rigged myself in Blender.

2D assets: icons and other UI elements were created with AI image tools and then adjusted to fit the game's style.

Code: I used AI coding assistants to help write the game systems, such as the combat simulation and the enemy AI, but I still did a lot of debugging and redesigning myself.

The game design, mechanics and balancing are my own work.

I'd love to hear your feedback, and I'm happy to answer questions about the AI workflow.

Free Demo Link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268040/Merkalis\_Conquest/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268040/Merkalis_Conquest/)
